newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-C-C Amatil, Telstra form alliance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-C-C Amatil, Telstra form alliance.

text.p: Bottler Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd (CCA) and government-owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp said on Wednesday they would form a business alliance to develop jointly their vending machine and pay-phone businesses.

"The alliance brings together the two largest operators of unattended points of sale in Australia with CCA currently running 60,000 vending machines and Telstra some 80,000 payphones across the country," they said.
The alliance would jointly cover equipment purchase and distribution of vending machines and pay-phones. It would also cover marketing, site selection, security and cash management.
